items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Now, Prince Robinson, he used to work with Duke years ago... And he's got his money and he's saving his money... So somehow, Prince Robinson lost his traveler's checkbook... And they finally give it back to him.

ctx.x: Why? 'Cause his wife ran things. A la Gladys Hampton, the late Gladys Hampton. She'd make out the checks and pay the fellows off and everything. Cootie didn't have a word to say. So I knew I wouldn't like that. I went to rehearsal.

So while I'm rehearsing, Sid say, "Come on, brother, let's go back to Louis Armstrong. Let's go with Louis." He had been with Louis before. I say, "Yeah?" I thought I was small. I say, "Well, who's going to buy the uniforms?" He says, "Mohawk'll buy them." I can't think of his name, a little cut down to his bitty dude, played bass. He had had my uniforms
